title: Chicken and Pineapple Stir-Fry
description: frying pan and stir well. Add the meatballs to the sauce and simmer for a further 8–10 minutes.

ingredients.text: 500g diced chicken breast (skin and visible fat removed)
½ red onion, peeled and sliced
½ red pepper, deseeded and sliced
½ green pepper, deseeded and sliced
320g fresh pineapple, cored, skin removed and chopped
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
50g uncooked basmati rice per portion, cooked according to packet instructions (+

steps: Spray a large frying pan with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a medium heat.
Add the diced chicken and fry for 5 minutes until it is browned on all sides.
Add the red onion and peppers and fry for a further 5 minutes until softened.
Place the soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic granules, sriracha and granulated sweetener into a small bowl and mix until combined.
Add the pineapple to the frying pan and pour over the sauce.
Stir until the chicken and vegetables are coated in the sauce and cook  for 4–5 minutes until the sauce has thickened and become sticky.
Stir the spring onions through, season to taste and serve. You can also freeze the dish once cooled for another day – just remember to defrost thoroughly before reheating.
